The harness scores only the inspiration/template catalog match (buildSearchTokens/scoreBlob/scoreQueryTokens/merge/hasStrict). It does NOT reproduce: topic-page redirects, the concept-expansion secondary pass on templates (page.tsx lines ~760-793, template-rail-only, does not touch inspirations), the client-side template matcher (lib/searchTemplateMatch.ts), bot/garbage-UA gating (no real user-agent in an offline harness — isGarbage is reproduced, isBot is not applicable), or any rendering-layer behavior. Historical baseline (from the live Playwright collector) reflects the FULL page including these features, so baseline vs. harness-Mode-A counts are not perfectly comparable on an absolute basis — relevance verdicts (the primary comparison signal) are unaffected by this gap.

Historical baseline (2026-07-07) predates not just Stage 5/6 but also Stage 2's Fix1/Fix2 phrase-protection commits (4210e21f, c062e618) — it is an even earlier 'before' than a strict Stage-5/6-only ablation baseline would be. Documented, not hidden: this makes the baseline-vs-D comparison in hard_queries_68_before_after.csv slightly more generous toward D than a strict pre-Stage-2 vs Stage-6 comparison would be, since some precision fixes baseline lacks are Stage 2's, not Stage 5/6's. The separately-computed harness Mode A (in hard_queries_68_ablation.csv) is the strict, code-accurate 'neither' for d/g attribution purposes.

Discovered during this run, not previously documented at this scale: a generic single-word LLM decomposition/rewrite slot (e.g. 'poster', 'design', 'template') can flood results catalog-wide when combined with Stage 6's real tokenization (23/68 = 34% of Mode D rows exceeded 1000 results, two hit the full 3209-record catalog exactly when the slot value was itself the stopword 'template', which produces zero primary tokens and a trivially-true allPrimary check). This is the same class of risk Stage 5 Section 12 and Stage 6 Section 17 already flagged from 2 examples each; this run quantifies it across the full 68-query set. Not fixed in this stage (forbidden by scope) — see Known Limitations / Remaining Risks in the summary.
LLM rewrite calls (gpt-4o-mini, temperature=0.4) are inherently non-deterministic; a re-run would not reproduce byte-identical rewrite text, though the same gating/caching/parsing logic would apply.

The relevance judge (gpt-4o-mini, temperature=0) is itself an LLM and can misjudge; a representative manual spot-check (all count-increased-but-relevance-decreased rows, all >1000-result rows, the one in-scope named-risk query, all zero-result transitions in both directions) plus an automated cross-consistency check across all 272 judge outputs (PASS-but-noisy / FAIL-but-apparently-fine) found zero internal inconsistencies and confirmed judge output against raw evidence in every manually re-read case.

5 of the 6 explicitly-named risk query families in the Stage 7 prompt (蔚来ES6, 比亚迪海豹, 白箱, 五菱宏光, 蜜雪冰城) are NOT present in the actual 68-query gold set (grep-verified) — they appear only in Stage 5/6's own separate, smaller test matrices. Per this stage's explicit no-query-modification rule, they were not added to the 68. Only 二手奢侈品鉴定品牌视觉 is both in the 68 and in the named-risk list; it was checked (see summary).
